title: RWB-S9-E7011-APP: the monthly scorecard has no rule row of its own, no trigger, no job, no workflow of its own, no published scorecard read and no reporting channel
source: Template and Rules v1 R5.4, R5.5, R5.6, R7.3 and R9; split plan slice RWB-S9-E7011-APP; context pack S9 rwb-partner (service row, ownership rows, Architecture v5 slides 2, 4, 5, 8 and 12); legacy RWB-E7-011; FSD S9 Partner management v4 A2.8 and Requirements served; TSD S9 Partner management v3 T0.1 to T0.4, T2, T3.0 to T3.3, T5.2, T5.3 and T6.1; Business Rules and Routing Logic v4 rows R-UNI-25, R-UNI-27, R-UNI-38 to R-UNI-40 and R-UNI-45; LDM and Data Dictionary v8 partner, v_ace_score and rule_row; Event and Messaging Design v4 EV-20, EV-21 and EV-26; Epics 3 to 8 Specification v3 FEAT-PRM-08 and the endpoint sheet; Recovery Workbench API Specification v4 API-S9-001 to API-S9-006
description: (1) No rule row of the ten route sets of the Business Rules and Routing Logic v4 names partner scoring: R-UNI-25, R-UNI-27 and R-UNI-45 read the scorecard to re-select a partner, R-WO-34 and R-DIS-30 use measured return as a threshold, and R-UNI-38 governs the version, but none of the 448 rows sets, weights or thresholds the scorecard itself, so the rule set the run evaluates has no row ID and the story evaluates the set in force and invents none. (2) The monthly trigger has no source: FSD S9 A2.8.2 says the run receives a completed ACE batch, an event or a timer without choosing one, FSD S9 A2.8.4.4 declares no background event, the Ownership Map gives S9 no job and one workflow (InstructionWorkflow), and DP-10 is not in the key's pattern set, so the trigger is a platform Schedule binding with no source value. (3) No column, table or element holds the measures: partner carries seven fields and only score (DF-PRT-007) is a scorecard fact, TSD S9 T3.1 gives no monthly row, and SCR-36 plots a monthly score per partner against its measures with no published element behind it. (4) The scorecard read has no operation of its own: the Ownership Map gives S9 six operations and the published file names them, GET /partners (API-S9-001) returns Partner[] with score and no measure, and no source publishes the measures read. (5) The reporting channel is gone: the legacy integration point is Power BI, Arch v5 has no data lake and removes INT-19 and INT-20, rwb-reporting builds its read model from events, and S9 publishes no scorecard event because EV-20 and EV-21 carry an instruction and a result. (6) The plan's C and H rows are incomplete for the reads this run makes: the run consumes rwb-source-data and rwb-decision and depends on the workflow kit, and the plan carries C None and omits RWB-PLT-E1071-CON and RWB-PLT-E1072-CON, so the absences are recorded rather than added.
evidence: Business Rules and Routing Logic v4 rows R-UNI-25, R-UNI-27, R-UNI-38, R-UNI-39, R-UNI-40, R-UNI-45, R-WO-34 and R-DIS-30 and the Route sets sheet (ten route sets, no partner set); FSD S9 A2.8.1 to A2.8.4.4 and Screens; TSD S9 T0.2 (one workflow, no job), T3.1 (seven partner fields), T5.2.1 (six operations), T5.2.2 (one consumed contract and the partner gateway), T5.2.3 (SQL provided 0, consumed 0) and T6.1; context pack ownership rows (3 tables, 6 operations, 2 events, 0 jobs, 1 workflow); Event and Messaging Design v4 EV-20, EV-21 and EV-26; Architecture v5 slides 8 and 12 and the removal of INT-19 and INT-20
owner_role: Solution architect with the rwb-decision rule owner, the rwb-source-data owner and the platform scheduling owner
proposed: Build the run against the rule set in force, the two faked consumed reads and the platform Schedule binding; keep the measures, the trigger and the reporting channel as placeholders; close the P2 gap before Done by publishing the scorecard rule rows in rwb-decision, the two reads, and a reporting path or a recorded decision that no scorecard fact is reported

title: RWB-S9-E7011-CON: the scorecard baseline declares no operation, no event, no Schedule and no scorecard table, and the two consumed reads and the SCR-36 measures element have no published artefact
source: Template and Rules v1 R5.4, R5.5, R7.2 and R9; split plan slice RWB-S9-E7011-CON; context pack S9 rwb-partner; legacy RWB-E7-011; FSD S9 Partner management v4 A2.8 and Screens; TSD S9 Partner management v3 T0.1 to T0.4, T3.0 to T3.2, T5.2, T5.3, T6.1 and T-A.1; Business Rules and Routing Logic v4 rows R-UNI-38 and R-UNI-39; LDM and Data Dictionary v8 partner, v_ace_score and rule_row; Event and Messaging Design v4 EV-20, EV-21 and EV-26; Recovery Workbench API Specification v4 Partner element and API-S9-001 to API-S9-006
description: (1) No source publishes an operation for the scorecard or for its measures: the Ownership Map gives S9 six operations and all six belong to the panel, instruction, result and invoice stories, and GET /partners carries score but no measure, so the baseline declares no operation and the measures read carries a placeholder. (2) The two consumed reads have no published operation name: the ACE score read from rwb-source-data and the rule-set read from rwb-decision are class C in fact, no document names their operation, and the plan's C row is empty. (3) No event belongs to the step: EV-20 carries an instruction, EV-21 a result, EV-26 the ACE batch record for case creation, reconciliation, payment matching, booking confirmation and the write-off scan, and no catalogue row carries a score. (4) No Schedule belongs to the step and the trigger has no source: the Ownership Map gives S9 no job, FSD S9 A2.8.4.4 declares no background event and FSD S9 A2.8.2 leaves the trigger open. (5) No scorecard table or column exists: partner carries seven fields with score only, the standard record columns of TSD S9 T3.0 are the only addition a table gets, and the period has no home, so the baseline declares the entry and no new column. (6) The review target of FSD S9 A2.8.1 is set with DL22 and no source gives its value, so the baseline declares reference data with a placeholder.
evidence: Context pack S9 ownership rows (3 tables, 6 operations, 2 events, 0 jobs, 1 workflow); TSD S9 T0.2, T3.1, T3.2, T5.2.1, T5.2.2, T5.2.3, T5.3, T6.1 and T-A.1; FSD S9 A2.8.1, A2.8.2, A2.8.3.1 and A2.8.4.4 and Screens; Business Rules and Routing Logic v4 rows R-UNI-38 and R-UNI-39; Event and Messaging Design v4 EV-20, EV-21 and EV-26; API Specification v4 Partner element (score, Latest scorecard result) and API-S9-001 to API-S9-006; Architecture v5 slide 11 notes
owner_role: Solution architect with the rwb-source-data owner, the rwb-decision owner and the rwb-access owner
proposed: Tag the baseline with the unchanged partner element, the two consumed rows with their placeholders, the entry element, the rights, the five fakes and the four absence tests; publish the measured-and-rule reads and the measures element, or record the decision that the score is the only published scorecard fact, before Done
